changeHypothesis.summary: Russia-related energy disruption and already-strong Chinese mining profits reinforced the upstream resource profit pool. 中国神华 had durable long-contract pricing and high dividend support, but the stock had already rerated strongly and the contemporaneous forecast already embedded a 2022 profit step-up followed by near-flat 2023-24 growth.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: The long-contract coal pricing mechanism is multi-quarter, but the war-related spike is not automatically permanent.
disconfirmingEvidence: 中国神华 outperformed CSI300 by ~28.9pp over 20d and ~56.5pp over 60d.
The Mar27 forecast already raised 2022-24 profit expectations.
Forecast growth decelerated from +18.2% in 2022 to +3.1%/+1.4% thereafter.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The Mar27 report already expected 2022 profit +18.2% and then only +3.1%/+1.4% in 2023-24, at roughly 9x PE. The stock had strongly outperformed over both 20d and 60d.
expectations.thesisExpectation: The energy shock and higher long-contract pricing could keep coal earnings/dividends higher for longer than the published baseline.
expectations.measurableGap: The missing proof is not 2022 profit strength; it is whether 2023-24 earnings should be materially above an already-raised and nearly-flat baseline.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward multi-year PE/dividend path rather than current-year PE alone.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: War/contract-price conditions raise not only 2022 profit but also the 2023-24 normalized earnings path.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Post-2022 earnings must stay materially above the frozen near-flat baseline after normalization.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: 2022 remains excellent but 2023-24 follow the already-expected low-growth path while valuation/yield merely hold steady.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Q1/Q2 realized coal price and updated multi-year forecasts can test path durability.
